note: On starting point he is the ICP's own example made flesh: the rep offered the phrase and the prospect took it — 'it sounds like you went from all right to good. Now you want to go from good to great' / 'Yeah. In a way.' He is at 13% body fat, disciplined on food, and has already paid a couple of thousand dollars for coaching, so income is evidenced by behaviour rather than by disclosure. Health was the neglected area — by his own account of the incumbent programme's target market, 'middle-aged let themselves get out of shape'. Two misses. 'successful' fails purely as a discovery gap: his occupation was never asked in twenty-five minutes, which is now the third call in this batch where the ICP's primary criterion went untested, and it is notable that the rep told this prospect '70%, 60% are all business owners' without establishing whether the prospect was one. 'not_deconditioned' is recorded as a miss with a caveat — he is emphatically not deconditioned now, but he arrived at the incumbent programme as exactly the profile the ICP excludes, and the exclusion that actually matters here is again clinical rather than compositional: an actively symptomatic lumbar spine, which the stated ICP does not screen for at all.
